tagline: Healthcare real estate REIT specializing in senior housing and skilled nursing facilities
hero_kpi_rationale: Healthcare real estate acquisitions totaling $434.5 million in 2025, reflecting the company's portfolio growth strategy in the healthcare sector

kpis.explanation: Investments in healthcare real estate properties acquired during the year
kpis.description: Acquisitions of 11 managed senior housing communities, 24 additional units, and operations acquisitions totaling $434.5 million in 2025
kpis.signal: Significant acquisitions of senior housing communities and healthcare real estate

risks.title: Interest rate increases
risks.score_rationale: Rising interest rates could increase borrowing costs on the revolving credit facility and future debt, making the financing of new investments more expensive and negatively affecting stock price

risks.title: Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Inflation could increase the company's operating expenses, its tenants', borrowers', and managed senior housing communities' expenses at rates exceeding increases in rental revenues

risks.title: Pandemics and health crises
risks.score_rationale: Pandemics could have significant negative impact on operations and financial results, as demonstrated by the COVID-19 pandemic

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Intense competition in the healthcare real estate sector makes it difficult to identify and acquire properties at favorable prices

risks.title: Loss of key personnel
risks.score_rationale: Loss of key personnel could impair the company's ability to manage its operations and achieve strategic objectives

risks.title: Impairment of real estate assets
risks.score_rationale: The company faces exposure to impairment risk on real estate investments and loans due to deterioration in tenants' operating results and failure to recover invested amounts

risks.title: Environmental and climate risks
risks.score_rationale: Natural disasters and climate change could affect property operations and financial results

ai_positioning.summary: Sabra Health Care REIT does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 2025 10-K filing. No AI initiatives or investments are disclosed in the financial statements or management discussion and analysis
